-- Fullscreen Cool Red Alpha Overlay Effect on Execution
task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        screenGui.Name = "AlphaOverlayGui"
        screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
        
        if syn and syn.protect_gui then
            syn.protect_gui(screenGui)
            screenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        elseif gethui then
            screenGui.Parent = gethui()
        else
            screenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        end

        local bgFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        bgFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        bgFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
        bgFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
        bgFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        bgFrame.Parent = screenGui

        local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 100)
        titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.35, 0)
        titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        titleLabel.Text = "ALPHA"
        titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        titleLabel.TextScaled = true
        titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
        titleLabel.Parent = bgFrame

        task.wait(2.5)
        
        for i = 0.2, 1, 0.05 do
            bgFrame.BackgroundTransparency = i
            titleLabel.TextTransparency = i - 0.2
            task.wait(0.02)
        end
        screenGui:Destroy()
    end)
end)

-- Brookhaven RP Name & Bio Change Function (Fixed)
local function setBrookhavenBio()
    local rpNameText = "Apx 🌸 spammer"
    local rpBioText = "Apx 🌸spammer Brookhaven Delta ke liye hai"

    task.spawn(function()
        local re = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RE", 15)
        if re then
            local rpNameEvent = re:FindFirstChild("RPName") or re:WaitForChild("RPName", 10)
            local rpBioEvent = re:FindFirstChild("RPBio") or re:WaitForChild("RPBio", 10)

            for i = 1, 10 do
                if rpNameEvent then
                    pcall(function()
                        rpNameEvent:FireServer(rpNameText)
                    end)
                end

                if rpBioEvent then
                    pcall(function()
                        rpBioEvent:FireServer(rpBioText)
                    end)
                end
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Helper Function to Send Chat Messages
local function sendMessage(msg)
    if #msg > 200 then
        msg = msg:sub(1, 200)
    end
    
    pcall(function()
        local chatEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
        if chatEvent and chatEvent:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then
            chatEvent.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
    
    pcall(function()
        local textChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
        if textChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local generalChannel = textChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if generalChannel then
                generalChannel:SendAsync(msg)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function createAtSymbols()
    local borderAt = ""
    for i = 1, 35 do
        borderAt = borderAt .. "@"
    end
    return borderAt
end

local spamMessages = {
    createAtSymbols() .. " APX H8R - Teri mummy ne tujhe paida karke galti kar di " .. createAtSymbols(),
    createAtSymbols() .. " APX H8R - Tera face dekh ke darwaza band kar deta hai " .. createAtSymbols(),
    createAtSymbols() .. " APX H8R - Tu itna bekar hai ki mirror bhi tod deta hai " .. createAtSymbols(),
    createAtSymbols() .. " APX H8R - Teri aukat to tractor se bhi kam hai " .. createAtSymbols(),
    createAtSymbols() .. " APX H8R - Tere dimaag mein to sirf dhool hai " .. createAtSymbols()
}

local spamActive = false
local currentSpeed = 0.5

-- Helper Function: Apply Rainbow Color Effect on Button Click
local function makeRainbowOnClick(buttonInstance)
    task.spawn(function()
        local hue = 0
        local connection
        connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            hue = (hue + 0.01) % 1
            local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
            pcall(function()
                if buttonInstance and buttonInstance.Parent then
                    buttonInstance.BackgroundColor3 = rainbowColor
                else
                    connection:Disconnect()
                end
            end)
        end)
        task.wait(4)
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
    end)
end
